title: Spicy Japanese Udon Stir Fry
description: A vibrant and flavorful stir fry made with udon noodles, vegetables, and a spicy kick. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the udon noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil, vibrant bell peppers, and spicy miso paste.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the japanese soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the noodles and vegetables to a serving dish.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds (if using).
Optional: Add protein such as cooked chicken or tofu for added flavor and nutrition.
